As Dehen tends to, this durable and good looking jacket stands on the shoulders of something old and original. The 12 oz. Sage cotton with a dry wax finish, milled in Scotland by our friends at Halley Stevensons, is the perfect fabric for this piece. It's a nod to the weather resistant fabric of early Deck Jackets, while presenting a handsome and finished look.
So whether you want to beat it up in the great out-of-doors, or just wear it around town, it's ready for you. Just be prepared for the compliments!

• 12 oz. Sage 100% cotton w / dry wax finish, milled in Scotland by Halley Stevensons
• 2 x 2 knit cuffs / waistband / collar
• 100% worsted wool trim knit at Dehen factory
• Brown straight satin lining
• Vintage raglan sleeve construction

• Wind guard w / zig-zag stitch detail

Just when you thought you had all of the Dehen you needed, allow us to introduce the Dehen 1920 Striped Wool Scarf! We've tinkered with various scarf patterns and finishing techniques over the years so we're proud to finally announce that we've cracked the code! These handsome "Made in America" scarves feature a 1x1 rib stitch (the same as our Watch Caps), a classic collegiate striping pattern and are the perfect length to wear long or doubled up when the temps warrant. And weighing in at nearly 1 pound of yarn each, they stand up to the cold and embody that "Heavy Duty Old School Truth" Dehen 1920 is known for!
These colorways have been selected from our seasonal and classic yarn colors, so they are sure to fit right in with your Dehen wardrobe! Shall we apologize now for adding yet another Dehen 1920 must have?

Designed to be worn crossbody or around the waist, it features a large main compartment that easily fits a 1-litre water bottle, smartphone, and wallet, along with a discreet rear pouch ideal for passports and other valuables.
